An '''electric shaver''' was a device which was capable of holding charge. The [[Socorro/Legends|Socorron]] gambler [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] owned an electric shaver and in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] [[Gender/Legends|he]] came to believe he may have to resort draining the charge from it into his [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|ship's]] energy storage system in an attempt to give it enough energy to take off from the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Oseon 2795]], which he was visiting to play the game [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]].<ref name="LC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Electric shavers were first mentioned in [[1983]] the novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'' the first novel in the [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] which was written by [[L. Neil Smith]].
